title: Evaluation of coupled ocean–atmosphere simulations of the mid-Holocene using palaeovegetation data from the northern hemisphere extratropics
problem: Existing coupled ocean-atmosphere models produce inconsistent and sometimes inaccurate simulations of mid-Holocene regional climates, particularly regarding Eurasian vegetation and European winter temperatures, which are not robustly supported by palaeovegetation data and differ significantly between models.
method: The authors evaluate mid-Holocene climate simulations by driving the BIOME4 vegetation model with climate model output and comparing the resulting simulated vegetation patterns with palaeovegetation reconstructions derived from pollen data.
task: The task is to evaluate six coupled ocean-atmosphere simulations of the mid-Holocene by comparing the model-driven vegetation changes with palaeovegetation data from the northern hemisphere extratropics to assess the simulations' realism.
